title: 2013 AMC 8 Problem 23
statement: In \(\triangle ABC\), \(\angle ABC\) is a right angle. The sides of \(\triangle ABC\) are the diameters of semicircles as shown. The area of the semicircle on \(\overline{AB}\) equals \(8\pi,\) and the arc of the semicircle on \(\overline{AC}\) has length \(8.5\pi.\) What is the radius of the semicircle on \(\overline{BC}?\)

solutions.text:
The semicircle on \(\overline{AB}\) has area \(8\pi\), so its full circle would have area \(16\pi\). Its radius is therefore \(4\), and \(AB=8\).

A semicircle of radius \(r\) has arc length \(\pi r\). Since the arc on \(\overline{AC}\) has length \(8.5\pi\), its radius is \(8.5\), so \(AC=17\).

Using the Pythagorean theorem in right triangle \(ABC\), \[BC=\sqrt{17^2-8^2}=\sqrt{225}=15.\] The radius of the semicircle on \(\overline{BC}\) is \(\frac{15}{2}=7.5\).

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: Use the semicircle on \(AB\) to find \(AB\).
The arc length on \(AC\) gives the radius, hence diameter \(AC\).
